certified_rear_depth: Infinite within the stated rear footprints, over the complete declared 40 mm vertical stroke.
method: Nominal and 2 mm enlarged finite reservations are subsets of the independently derived infinite rear-face prisms. Exact fixed-solid intersections and invariant moving-solid axial bounds certify the full stroke, including heatsink access behind the stated footprints.
assumptions: Controller is reserved geometry matching the 42 mm NEMA17 face, with 2 mm extra lateral/depth clearance. Unknown controller/heatsink/cable mass is excluded from the stage gravity estimate. No controller electronics or heat-transfer analysis is claimed.
